pr_title: roachtest: update activerecord blocklist and ignore list
pr_body:
This patch updates the blocklist and ignore list for the
activerecord roachtest. This patch also eliminates the
per-version lists since each release branch uses their
own list now.

Fixes #84955

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/92793)

Fixed a few typos

bors r=ZhouXing19,rafiss
